rules.description: Per-rule overrides: turn rules off or change their severity.

ignore.description: Patterns in .gitignore syntax (relative to the scanned folder) whose findings are not reported, e.g. "extensions/**" or "scripts/vendor_*/". A leading ! brings back something an earlier pattern ignored. Applied after any .gmlscanignore files. Files in a .yyp project are still read, so functions and assets defined there stay known.

runtime.description: Target GameMaker runtime version, e.g. "2023.1.1.81". Defaults to the IDEVersion in the .yyp.

threatModels.description: Untrusted data sources to track: remote (network, HTTP, Steam) and/or local (files, INI, clipboard, command line, keyboard_string).

globalPrefixes.description: Variables whose names start with one of these prefixes are treated as declared globals.

taint.description: Extra taint models, e.g. for networking or shell extensions.

sanitizers.description: Functions whose return value is always safe.

patterns.description: Custom pattern rules. $NAME matches any expression; ... matches any arguments or statements.

id.description: Rule id; reported as custom/<id> unless it contains a slash.

message.description: Message; $NAME is replaced by the matched code.

events.description: Only match in these object events, e.g. ["Step", "Draw GUI"].

dependencies.description: Update checks for extensions and libraries copied into the project.

checkUpdates.description: Look for newer versions that support the project's GameMaker version (needs network access). The GitHub Action checks by default; the command line only with --check-updates or when this is true.

runtimeUpdates.description: Also report newer GameMaker runtimes, and dependency updates that need one.

autoUpdate.description: GitHub Action: open pull requests that update extensions, on runs on the default branch. Needs contents: write and pull-requests: write.

ignore.description: Dependencies, versions or kinds of update not to report or open pull requests for.

oneOf.description: Dependency name, extension name or version-macro stem.

versions.description: Versions to skip: "3.x", "2.1.*" or exact versions.

sources.description: Extra dependencies to check, such as your own libraries or extensions.

macro.description: Version macro, e.g. MYLIB_VERSION for #macro MYLIB_VERSION "1.2.3".

github.description: owner/repo on GitHub; versions come from its releases (or tags).

asset.description: Regular expression for the release asset with the .yymps; a capture group gives the version.

autoUpdate.description: Set false to never open update pull requests for this extension.
